title: Saint Neophytos Enkleistra
scope: The Enkleistra at Agios Neophytos Monastery, specifically the cliffside hermitage, cell and chapel exterior, high terrace, diagonal stair and immediate ravine crossing as photographed in 1888.
limitations: The model represents the historic Enkleistra exterior and immediate approach. The later main church on the other bank is a separate building.
The exact form within the deep cliff, the outer passage, stair widths, retaining-wall details, geological surfaces and material colors are inferred from the archive view and mapped dimensions.
June 15 is a representative date within the documented 1888 journey year. The original caption does not give a calendar day.
